scope: Handle the handset's idle CLOSED/CLOSING boundary without resetting unread data or bypassing ownership checks
changes: Claim requires local CLOSED/DTR zero, peer CLOSED/DSR zero or CLOSING with a valid boolean DSR, and eight identical empty snapshots after firmware exit and mapping/ownership qualification
Strict closedAndEmpty remains distinct from idleAndEmpty; the peer state is never overwritten to manufacture CLOSED
Opening accepts peer OPENING or OPENED, then waits for peer OPENED/DTR and zero indices under the same finite poll budget
Local close accepts an idle CLOSING peer; retirement repeats mapping and eight-snapshot qualification and only stops local access
The final screen reports both DTR signals, binding state, remote state-update flag and last-snapshot validity
Every snapshot revalidates Device mappings before control reads, including the first snapshot after ExitBootServices and before claim polling

validation.reproduction_before_fix: 310 simulated checks, 10 failures including the photographed state pair and two-phase opening
validation.native_smd_memory_and_teardown: 820 ASan/UBSan checks, zero failures; simulated peer and MMIO
